name: Unverified_35bc
fix_description: The function 0x2dad6442 (stake withdrawal) calls func_2D5C to transfer NFT via safeTransferFrom before updating the stake state (storage[var0+0x06], etc). The ERC721 onERC721Received callback allows reentrancy. Fix by updating state (mark slot as claimed) before making the external transfer call, or add a nonReentrant modifier.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short multi-step AMM reserve-manipulation attack using a flash loan, swap, repeated skim abuse, and swap-back repayment. It requires understanding UniswapV2 pair accounting and how skim can be abused with a deflationary/fee-on-transfer style token, so it is not trivial, but the PoC itself is still fairly compact and straightforward for an experienced DeFi auditor.
